steps.en: Install Kilo where you work — the VS Code extension or the terminal CLI
steps.zh: 在你干活的地方装 Kilo——VS Code 扩展或终端 CLI

steps.en: Sign in with a Kilo account (no API key) or plug in your own provider key, then pick a model
steps.zh: 用 Kilo 账号登录（零 key）或插上自己的供应商 key，再挑一个模型

steps.en: Describe the multi-file change in natural language, starting in Plan mode
steps.zh: 用自然语言描述多文件改动，先交给 Plan 模式

steps.en: Designs the change and writes the implementation plan before any code is written
steps.zh: 在写任何代码前先设计改动、写下实现计划

steps.en: Edits across files, runs terminal and browser commands, self-checks, then shows you a diff
steps.zh: 跨文件编辑、跑终端与浏览器命令、自我检查，再给出 diff

value.en: Real multi-file edits — planned first, reviewable as a diff — inside the editor you already use, billed at the model provider's own rate
value.zh: 在你已有的编辑器里完成先规划、可当 diff 审的真实多文件改动，按模型供应商原价计费
